description: Address v2 review issues: one-to-many flattening, unresolvable tables, filter type coercion, description field
steps: Fix one-to-many array flattening in executeReport - take first array element
Add direction field to JoinPath in resolveJoins
Skip unresolvable tables in buildSupabaseQuery select string
Parse numeric filter values to Number in client-side filter comparison
Add description state and textarea to step 6 in builder page
acceptance_criteria: Array nested values are handled by taking the first element
JoinPath has a direction field indicating many-to-one or one-to-many
Unresolvable tables are skipped in the select string
Numeric filter values are parsed with Number() before comparison
Description is included in save payload
Description is loaded when editing a template
verification: Run npm run build and confirm no TypeScript errors
findings: All 4 review issues addressed. Build passes (only pre-existing /employees/new env var error remains). TypeScript compiles cleanly with tsc --noEmit. Template loading now re-resolves joins via resolveJoins() to get correct direction info instead of mapping from stored config.
